title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
why_read: An interesting art/HCI installation concept but low technical substance for a software engineering audience.
analysis: Diffusion TV is an interactive art installation using a modified CRT and antenna knob to let users physically manipulate the denoising process of a diffusion model as a metaphor for generative AI, situated in an HCI/art context rather than as a technical advance. It's a creative approach to explainable AI through embodied interaction, but offers little in the way of transferable engineering techniques or benchmarks. Worth a passing mention for HCI-curious readers, but not core technical content.
